macro_context: FIIs turned net buyers in a big way, pouring over $1B into Indian equities last week - the biggest weekly buying since June 2025 - a bullish flow signal. Countering that, the rupee faces a bearish options-market bias as oil pangs resurface on escalating US-Iran tensions; the same Middle East escalation lifted Eurozone bond yields on inflation concern and dragged Japan's Nikkei lower on the oil price jump. Domestically, HDFC Bank's MD flagged El-Nino and a below-normal monsoon as a growth/inflation risk for FY27. In the US, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh unveiled expert panels to overhaul the central bank's policy framework - a headline event, not yet a clear directional catalyst for India.
